overallAssessment: Generate operator correctly implements the full flow from prompt to API to history storage with proper error handling

codeQuality.structure: Clean operator implementation following Blender conventions
codeQuality.pollMethod: Correctly validates prompt before allowing execution
codeQuality.errorHandling: Errors properly reported through Blender's reporting system
codeQuality.undoSupport: Operator uses 'REGISTER', 'UNDO' options for proper undo support

triggeredByButton.actual: bl_idname = 'ai.generate' can be triggered by button with operator='ai.generate'

generatingStatus.actual: Sets scene.ai_is_generating = True and scene.ai_status = 'Generating...' before API call

historyStorage.actual: _add_to_history() called on success with timestamp, prompt, script

errorDisplay.actual: Error status set to scene.ai_status, self.report({'ERROR'}, ...) used

promptValidation.expected: Poll validates prompt not empty and <= 1000 chars

apiKeyValidation.actual: Checks prefs.api_key_status != 'Configured' and cancels with error if not

suggestions.description: Consider adding a 'Cancel Generation' operator for long-running API calls
